notes: Item 19 discloses gross sales data for Baja Fresh franchised stores for the period December 1, 2024 through November 30, 2025. Three cohorts reported: all franchised outlets (n=65), top 20% (n=13), and bottom 20% (n=13). Data sourced from weekly sales reports provided by franchisees; not audited. Gross sales defined as total revenue from sales of goods and services less sales tax, discounts, allowances, and returns. As of November 30, 2025, 67 franchised stores were open; 65 qualified for inclusion (existing, not opened for first time during fiscal year, not temporarily closed at start or end of year).
